{{Top|leg}}
A '''steam rover''' was a half-tracked [[Groundcar/Legends|groundcar]] designed by the [[Tasari]]. The vehicle was powered by a [[steam turbine]] that used compressed [[Hydrogen/Legends|hydrogen]] and [[Helium/Legends|helium]] to heat steam in a boiler. The steam powered pistons in the engine. The steam turbine incorporated an [[airscoop]] that separated, compressed, then replaced [[Gas/Legends|gas]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Barimoq Industries]] manufactured steam rovers including the [[All Terrain Cruiser K-111]].<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|Tasariq: The Crystal Planet}}</ref>
